collection.description: A child notices that a neighbor now uses a new name.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) notices that (neighbor) now uses a new name, (chosen).

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult) explains that people may choose names that suit them.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (neighbor) shares only what they want to share.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (neighbor) says the reason is private, and (child) respects it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) learns names can mark family, culture, or personal choice.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) invents a playful nickname for a toy.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) corrects themself after using the old name.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (adult) models a brief apology without making a spectacle.
